title: Timic Unification Program — Compositional Research Architecture, Measurement and Cross-Scale Translation
status: archive-generated unification framework; not a validated physical Theory of Everything
scientific_abstract: The Timic Unification Program organizes recovered Tim equations, later archive formalisms, symbolic structures, network models, theology and established science into a typed architecture rather than forcing them into one undifferentiated physical equation. Version 2 adds a scientific measurement envelope around Potato Dynamics: parameters, units, uncertainty, baseline models and observational data are now mandatory for empirical instantiations. Cross-domain analogies are represented by translation maps whose preserved operations and mismatches can be tested, while cross-scale claims require coarse-graining maps and quantified approximation error. This changes the unification target from 'one formula for everything' to compositional compatibility: domain-specific models may connect only when their variables, boundaries, measurement maps and conserved or approximately preserved structures match. The resulting programme is simultaneously broader and stricter: theology, social systems, biology and field theory can share structural primitives such as relation, boundary, flow, storage, observation, transformation and recurrence, but each retains its own units, causal claims and empirical standards.
purpose: Organize recovered Tim equations, later archive formalisms, symbolic structures, psychology, network models, theology and established science into a compact set of typed primitives and transformation laws. The goal is not one physical ontology for everything, but explicit translation rules, model composition and failure boundaries.
central_rule: Unification = shared architecture + explicit type system + domain-specific equations + compatible interfaces + measurement + mismatch statements. A useful cross-domain law must say what is preserved, what changes, which variables belong to which domain, and what would make the analogy fail.

model_composition_contract.abstract: Models compose only through compatible interfaces; symbolic similarity does not license algebraic substitution.
model_composition_contract.compatibility: A->B is scientifically meaningful only if outputs of A map to admissible inputs/states of B with an explicit T_AB and quantified uncertainty/error where empirical consequences are claimed.
model_composition_contract.failure: If units/types do not map, keep the relationship comparative rather than composing the equations.

cross_scale_contract.meaning: A proposed microscopic mechanism supports a macroscopic effective model only to the extent that evolution approximately commutes with coarse-graining in a declared regime.

cross_domain_contract.dynamical_test: Delta_T(X)=d_B[T_AB(F_A(X)),F_B(T_AB(X))] where a meaningful metric exists
cross_domain_contract.interpretation: A formal analogy is stronger when it preserves a specified operation approximately and exposes its mismatch quantitatively.
cross_domain_contract.rule: Never infer physical causation merely because two domains instantiate the same abstract pattern.

theory_quality_ladder: T3 calibrated model with uncertainty and identifiable parameters
research_findings: The strongest common grammar is relational and operational rather than a hidden physical substance.
A unified architecture should add measurement metadata around P+ instead of forcing empirical quantities into the symbolic master tuple.
Boundary architecture and objective function are necessary: topology alone cannot distinguish House from Shell or Garden from Farm.
Cross-scale maps are the principal missing bridge in ambitious micro/macro claims.
Ladder is best modeled as a hybrid sequence of typed Doors or as axial displacement superposed on recurrence, depending the domain.
Spudlight/Eye/Door forms a general signal->measurement/inference->transition circuit, but light energy, information and attention remain different units.
Covenant becomes mathematically interesting as a stateful persistent edge with breach and repair states.
New Jerusalem becomes a high-level integration target: connectivity restored without loss of differentiation.
The Schwarzschild compactness/curvature calculation demonstrates the project's general method: decompose apparently synonymous concepts into independent measurable variables before synthesizing them.
Derived epiphanies should be folded into canonical owners only when they simplify multiple branches, preserve provenance and survive type/unit checks.
